title: Innovitech Currency Converter
description: A simple console application that performs currency conversions using real-time exchange rates.

ModalContent: Implemented a console-based application that retrieves real-time exchange rates from an external API.
Focused on clean separation of concerns between data fetching, business logic, and user interaction.
Handled API communication, error cases, and fallback scenarios to ensure reliability.
This project helped deepen my understanding of working with external services and data validation.

title: BinOp - Binary Operations
description: A console app for performing and experimenting with mathematical operations on binary numbers.

ModalContent: Developed a console application to perform and visualize binary operations and conversions.
Focused on implementing operations manually instead of relying on built-in language features to better understand low-level behavior.
Designed the application to be educational, making binary logic easier to follow step-by-step.
Strengthened my understanding of how computers handle data at a fundamental level.

title: Portfolio - Admin application
description: A graphical admin application for managing the data displayed on the portfolio website.

ModalContent: Built a web-based admin interface to manage the content of my portfolio site dynamically.
Designed the system around JSON-based data storage, enabling a lightweight and flexible content management approach.
Implemented forms and validation to edit projects, CV entries, and other sections without directly modifying code.
This project reflects my focus on building maintainable systems and reducing manual content updates.
